paper_claim: Grounding-first human adaptation creates transferable visual and person-conditioned decoder representations inside a VLM without requiring an external segmenter.
hypothesis: Separating global person grounding from short box-conditioned person decoding will avoid permutation and long-sequence exposure errors while still adapting Qwen Vision and Qwen LLM to human pose, mask, age, and gender supervision.
falsifier: Close the branch if predicted-box free inference cannot pass the frozen 64-image owner-binding gate, or if the 5K pilot remains collapsed on pose or mask despite passing GT-box diagnostics.
paper_destination: source representation for Stage-2 and Stage-3 transfer

representation.dataflow: Turn A: full image -> all person boxes. Turn B: full image plus one person box -> one Human Slot containing pose, mask tokens, gender, and age.
representation.human_id: The predicted person box is the persistent slot key; every Turn-B record is attached to exactly one Turn-A box.
representation.box: Four loc1000 tokens generated by the native tied Qwen LM head.
representation.pose: One box-conditioned short sequence of 17 COCO joints, each encoded by box-relative x, y, and visibility tokens; never concatenate poses for multiple people.
representation.segment: Sixteen repeated <mask> tokens whose final hidden states retrieve a binary person mask by scaled dot product with Qwen output image-token states, following UFO; no polygon generation and no learned mask decoder.
representation.attributes: Gender and age tokens generated in the same one-person Turn-B response.
representation.decoder: native tied Qwen causal LM head for box, pose, age, and gender plus decoder-free mask embedding retrieval
representation.owner_binding: Training uses GT boxes with bounded jitter; paper-facing evaluation uses only predicted Turn-A boxes. GT-box evaluation is diagnostic only.

trainable: Qwen Vision LoRA across all 24 blocks
Qwen LLM attention and MLP LoRA
training.loss: LM cross-entropy for box/pose/attribute tokens plus focal and dice losses on embedding-retrieval masks
training.box_jitter: Apply bounded training jitter and reject invalid boxes so Turn-B is robust to Turn-A errors.
training.resolution: Approximately one-megapixel native-aspect full image; no random crop that changes person ownership.
training.teacher_forcing: Training mechanism only; all paper-facing metrics use predicted boxes and free generation.

requirements: focal/dice mask gradients reach Qwen image states
predicted-box records preserve one-to-one owner identity
G0_codec.decision: No GPU run before the revised interface and owner-binding tests pass.

G2_pilot_generated_validation.decision: No full Stage-1 training if owner binding, segment, or pose remains collapsed.

G3_full_stage1.validation_split: COCO-UniHuman val under paper-aligned no-small-person scoring
G3_full_stage1.decision: Stage-2 starts only after all five predicted-box capability requirements pass.

controls: mask embedding retrieval versus polygon output on the same 5K split
Qwen Vision frozen versus jointly adapted

prior_evidence.Pix2Seq_v2: Box-conditioned polygon and keypoint sequences; 1024 multi-task COCO AP 38.2 mask and 64.8 keypoint.
prior_evidence.UFO_2025: Decoder-free 16-mask-token embedding retrieval; InternVL2.5-8B COCO instance mask AP 45.8.
prior_evidence.Youtu_VL_2026: Authors recommend grounding then crop/segmentation because basic polygon precision is limited.
prior_evidence.VisionLLM_v2: High-precision VLM perception uses routing queries and dense decoders; COCO mask AP 47.8 and pose AP 74.0.

reopen_policy: A task-specific pose decoder becomes the next branch only if box-conditioned pose tokens fail G2; an external SAM decoder remains outside Stage-1 mainline.
closure_reason: The user selected a mature high-fidelity Stage-1 rather than an experimental decoder-minimal compromise. Box-conditioned pose and mask retrieval remain diagnostic controls.
